## Checklist

<!-- Post this, filled in, as the pull request's first comment, not in its description:
the description becomes the commit message on main (CONTRIBUTING.md › Commits and pull
requests). -->

- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behaviour
- [ ] For a bug fix: a test that fails without the fix (QA-11)
- [ ] Manual test cases and fixtures in `docs/testing/` added or updated (for a new feature or behaviour change)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `README.md`) if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] New design decision recorded as an ADR, if there is one
- [ ] Open issues checked: the ones this fixes, finishes, conflicts with or makes obsolete are named in the description
